description: Defines a mock class 'MockHttp2Visitor' for testing HTTP/2 visitor interface in the quiche project, including mock methods for various HTTP/2 events.

classes.name: MockHttp2Visitor
classes.description: A mock implementation of Http2VisitorInterface for testing purposes.

methods.name: OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Mock method for handling readiness to send data.

methods.name: OnConnectionError
methods.description: Mock method for handling connection errors.

methods.name: OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Mock method called when a frame header is received.

methods.name: OnSettingsStart
methods.description: Mock method called at the start of settings exchange.

methods.name: OnSetting
methods.description: Mock method for individual setting received.

methods.name: OnSettingsEnd
methods.description: Mock method called at the end of settings exchange.

methods.name: OnSettingsAck
methods.description: Mock method for settings acknowledgment.

methods.name: OnBeginHeadersForStream
methods.description: Mock method called when headers begin for a stream.

methods.name: OnHeaderForStream
methods.description: Mock method for header key-value pairs for a stream.

methods.name: OnEndHeadersForStream
methods.description: Mock method called when headers end for a stream.

methods.name: OnDataPaddingLength
methods.description: Mock method for data padding length.

methods.name: OnBeginDataForStream
methods.description: Mock method when data begins for a stream.

methods.name: OnDataForStream
methods.description: Mock method for data received for a stream.

methods.name: OnEndStream
methods.description: Mock method when a stream ends.

methods.name: OnRstStream
methods.description: Mock method for RST_STREAM frame.

methods.name: OnCloseStream
methods.description: Mock method when a stream is closed.

methods.name: OnPriorityForStream
methods.description: Mock method for stream priority updates.

methods.name: OnPing
methods.description: Mock method for ping frames.

methods.name: OnPushPromiseForStream
methods.description: Mock method for push promise frames.

methods.name: OnGoAway
methods.description: Mock method for GOAWAY frames.

methods.name: OnWindowUpdate
methods.description: Mock method for window update frames.

methods.name: OnBeforeFrameSent
methods.description: Mock method before a frame is sent.

methods.name: OnFrameSent
methods.description: Mock method after a frame is sent.

methods.name: OnInvalidFrame
methods.description: Mock method for invalid frames.

methods.name: OnBeginMetadataForStream
methods.description: Mock method when metadata begins for a stream.

methods.name: OnMetadataForStream
methods.description: Mock method for metadata for a stream.

methods.name: OnMetadataEndForStream
methods.description: Mock method when metadata ends for a stream.

methods.name: OnErrorDebug
methods.description: Mock method for debug messages.
